text.en: This Order may be cited as the Internal Security (Detained Persons) (Repeal) Order, 2020 and shall be deemed to have commenced on 1st April 1983. Repeal of S 17711964

The Internal Security (Detained Persons] Order, 1964 is hereby repealed. Made this 8th. day of Syaaban, 1441 Hijriah corresponding to the 2nd. day of April, 2020 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN, BRUNEI DARUSSALAM. Dicetak oleh Print Plus Sdn. Bhd., Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510, Negara Brunei Darussalam.
